content: Phase B1: Fix Coming Soon FOUC — hold render in PublicLayout with cream splash until site loads
Phase B2 backend: add hide-element toggles to SiteContent model (Header, About, Services, Gallery, Contact fields)
Phase B2 frontend: honor toggles in Header, About, Services, Gallery, Contact pages
Phase B3 backend: add header_nav_items list to SiteContent with defaults
Phase B3 frontend: render Header nav from site.header_nav_items with external URL + new_tab support
Phase B admin UI: add Header/Nav tab (nav CRUD + reorder + new_tab) and per-page tabs (About/Services/Gallery/Contact) with toggles to AdminSiteContent
Phase C backend: add palette_schedules to SiteContent + update /api/palettes/active to compute from schedules
Phase C frontend: add Schedules UI in AdminPalettes with add/edit/delete rules
Phase D backend: add custom_palettes collection + POST/DELETE admin endpoints + merge into /api/palettes
Phase D frontend: install colorthief, add Create-from-Photo workflow in AdminPalettes, list & manage custom palettes
Full testing_agent run: FOUC, hide toggles, nav CRUD, schedules, palette-from-photo end-to-end
